{{Quote|Surely you've heard of us. The Mek-Sha Tradehouse is one of the most notable up-and-coming auction establishments in the galaxy. We... procured... a number of high-value items when the Hutts were overthrown, had the brilliant idea to auction them off, and the rest is history!|[[Diihara Val]]|<ref name="TOR:HW" />}}
The '''Mek-Sha Tradehouse''' was an auction establishment based within [[Huttbreaker's compound]] on [[Mek-Sha]].<ref name="TOR:TR">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Tradehouse Requisitions|Mek-Sha}}</ref> It was founded by [[Huttbreaker]] following [[Huttbreaker's Rebellion]], during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:TGoMS" />

During the [[Third Galactic War|new conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Alliance Commander]] traveled to Huttbreaker's compound and spoke to Acquisitions Overseer [[Diihara Val]]. After speaking, the Commander accepted a position tasked with performing requisitions in order to increase the tradehouse's supply.<ref name="TOR:HW" />
